name: image-template-cozy-farming-sim-scene
title: Cozy Farming Sim Scene
description: A warm top-down pixel-art farm scene for a cozy life sim: tilled crop plots, a farmhouse, animals, a winding path and a small player character, built on a consistent tile grid with soft seasonal lighting. Slots for season, time of day, crops and buildings.

description_i18n.en: A warm top-down pixel-art farm scene for a cozy life sim: tilled crop plots, a farmhouse, animals, a winding path and a small player character, built on a consistent tile grid with soft seasonal lighting. Slots for season, time of day, crops and buildings.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 为治愈系生活模拟游戏生成温暖的俯视像素农场场景：已开垦的作物田、农舍、动物、蜿蜒小路和小小的玩家角色，基于统一的瓦片网格并带有柔和的季节光照。可调整季节、时段、作物和建筑。

query.en:
A gameplay-accurate scene from a cozy farming life sim, top-down three-quarter view, in {argument name="art_style" default="soft 16-bit pixel art on a 16x16 tile grid, gentle dark-brown outlines, no harsh black"}.

Season and time: {argument name="season" default="early autumn"}, {argument name="time_of_day" default="late afternoon golden hour"}.

# Scene contents
- A small wooden farmhouse with a smoking chimney in the upper-left, a porch with a rocking chair and a mailbox.
- Neat rows of tilled soil plots in the centre growing {argument name="crops" default="pumpkins, sunflowers and young wheat"}, a few freshly watered tiles slightly darker.
- {argument name="buildings" default="a red barn with an open door, a chicken coop and a small greenhouse"} along the right side.
- Animals: {argument name="animals" default="two chickens pecking near the coop and a sleepy cat on a fence post"}.
- The player character, {argument name="player" default="a farmer in overalls and a straw hat holding a watering can"}, small in frame on the dirt path beside the crops.
- A winding dirt path leading off the bottom edge, a pond with lily pads, fruit trees and a wooden fence line framing the farm.

# Composition and readability
- Read the scene as a real game screen: every object sits on the tile grid, walkable paths clearly lighter than grass, interactable objects (crops, mailbox, door) with slightly stronger outlines.
- Leave a calm band along the bottom for a toolbar UI to sit over later, but draw no UI.
- Characters and animals two to three tiles tall at most, consistent scale.

# Lighting and palette
- Warm low sun from the left, long soft shadows to the right, a faint warm haze.
- Palette: {argument name="palette" default="warm ochres, sage greens, brick red and cream, limited to about 32 colours"}.
- Cozy, safe, inviting mood: rounded shapes, nothing threatening.

# Avoid
Mixed pixel sizes, blurry or anti-aliased upscaling, isometric 3D rendering, UI, text, watermarks, real game logos, photographic textures.
